name: session-compass
description: Session Compass: a band above the Claude Code prompt that tells what the session is about (a one-line summary of your prompts so far, made again after each prompt or on 🔁) and has buttons to step back and forth through your prompts; the summary shows above Claude's question dialog too, at the band's width; output blocks fold with a ▼/▶ marker or all at once with 📖/📕 on the band, and the prompt a button lands on is marked with ▌

summaryMode.title: Summary mode
summaryMode.description: auto: remake the band's summary after each prompt. manual: make it once, then only when 🔁 on the band is pressed.
